::: {#def-plateau}
#### Plateau

For a [function](functions.qmd#def-function) $f : \reals^p \to \reals$,
a **plateau** is a region where the
[Euclidean norm](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-euclidean-norm)
of the [gradient](vector-calculus.qmd#def-vector-derivative),
$\norm{\deriv{\vx} f(\vx)}$,
is small but nonzero.
The surface is then nearly flat
without containing a [stationary point](#def-stationary-point).

:::
